BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VII
BRANCH: BT   SESSION : MO/2019

                                           SUBJECT : BT7035 IPR, BIOSAFETY & BIOETHICS

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) Define the term ‘intellectual property’ and categorize its types.  [2]
 (b) Assess the importance of geographical indications (GIs) citing suitable examples. [3]


Q2 (a) Identify the prerequisites of patentability.  [2]
 (b) Describe the significance of copyright and the rights protected under it. [3]


Q3 (a) Explain the significance of ‘Budapest treaty’. [2]
 (b) Describe the key changes made in the Second amendment of the Indian Patent Act 1970. [3]


Q4 (a) Outline the importance of ‘Hague Agreement’. [2]
 (b) Describe the salient features and benefits of Patent Cooperation Treaty. [3]


Q5 (a) Evaluate the importance of ‘provisional’ patent specification. [2]
 (b) Classify the types of patent applications. [3]


Q6 (a) Enlist the patent databases acquired by Indian Patent Office. [2]
 (b) Give a brief account on the forms and fees involved in filing of a patent. [3]
